items.summaryUk: Brussels pledged a further €3.3 bn with von der Leyen promising more is coming, even as Russia struck Kyiv's water system without a single missile intercepted and Ukraine hit back at two S-400 launchers in Bryansk that had bombed the capital hours earlier.

items.title: Thousands are starving in occupied Oleshky. People have no food, no way out, and Russian forces bomb incoming aid
items.summary: More than 6,000 people, including around 200 children, may remain trapped in the Russian-occupied city, where civilians lack food, water and medicine and some are risking mined fields to escape.

items.summary: The new funding comes as Ukraine appeals for more air defense to counter increasingly complex Russian attacks, including advanced missile and drone strikes on Kyiv.

items.title: “I can travel back to Finland and be safe. That is a luxury”: Sanna Marin on the Russian strike that stopped her train from Kyiv
items.summary: The former Finnish prime minister has visited Ukraine around ten times since the full-scale invasion. This trip, she says, had more air-raid alarms than any of them, and a Russian drone hit the train travelling beside hers to the Polish border.
